newsitem.title: UK: AEI launches seafreight tracking system in.
newsitem.headline: AEI launches seafreight tracking system in.

text.p: Air Express International said it has launched its ocean shipment tracking system, LOGIS-Ocean in the United States and Germany

The system enables customers to track their shipment in 'real-time' and is now operational in 22 U.S.and 14 German cities. The remaining 48 U.S cities where AEI is located will go on-line early August the company said in a statement.

In a related development, AEI said it is pilot-testing an electronic data interchange(EDI) messaging system with Hapag-Lloyd and Maersk Line, two of its ocean partners. successful, the message-exchange programme should be launched by the end of the summer.
LOGIS-OCean is already operational in four other countries, Belgium, Britain, the Netherlands and France. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
